events.notes: Viewed native mesh seeds2302/2309,normal and contrast40. NL returns do not restore the missing crossing family;seed2309 diagonal response is weaker and more grainy/fragmented than V168/V169. Seed2302 retains blotchy chromatic structure under amplification.

Absent mesh retains chromatic mottle. Main sky looks smooth at normal exposure;building/foliage do not show a decisive gain;coarse fence is rougher and less continuous in NL returns. Cab nominal left/right erase much of the fence to smooth fields;profile3879 left is speckly with weak diagonals. Both cab JPEGs and ISO100 references viewed,qualitative only.

Profile3879 cab right still misses crossings and looks grainy. Natural feather/butterfly/plant views show weaker fine texture,coarse colored grain or soft detail rather than a gain. ADC-only gray flats at128 and512 show a fine periodic colored pattern in both NL returns,absent in the near-uniform parent/V169. Noisy flats retain broad chromatic fields.

Viewed all flat triplets and medium/high gray boards. ISO12800 dark gray has less broad purple/green mottle with NL but fine periodic texture remains. ISO6400 dark chromatic flat is visibly rougher;medium/high gray lack a decisive normal-display improvement. Exact flat GT is uniform;the periodic pattern is not real scene detail.

Retained bird faint/dark boards lose branch and feather texture with NL and show periodic grain. Quiet vertical-step crops are smoother spatially in some areas but change color toward purple/red,especially ISO12800,with broad blobs and periodic texture. Normal-display edge board shows a thin rough transition in NL;quiet RMS alone cannot certify edge fidelity.

ISO12800 quiet triplets have strong purple bias. Narrow bar and slanted-edge normal boards show obvious dark/bright color fringes with direct Malvar;DINO hybrid reduces fringes but does not recover V169 edge quality. Quiet-side amplified fields retain false color and periodic texture despite lower spatial RMS.

ISO12800 slanted quiet field has red/purple bias and broad blobs. Striped-patch normal boards retain visibly less periodic scene contrast with NL and carry fine grid texture. ADC-only bark/fur boards show strong colored periodic pattern and less clean detail than V143/V169;this is a serious low-noise regression in this pipeline.

All four ADC sloped-plane boards viewed at original detail. Both NL returns add periodic colored texture,especially darker planes,where parent/V169 and exact constructed GT remain smooth. No safe low-noise identity behavior is established.
